patch_description: This crossover combines the current program’s direct-demand reward and pressure-discounted two-hop terms with the inspiration program’s endpoint-capacity signal and correlated-profile diversity penalties. Two-hop reward is distributed across all eligible intermediate nodes using demand support, transit pressure, and a congestion discount, rather than assigning the same reward to every possible path. The two-hop interactions are capped to the supported path structure, while diversity terms discourage redundant same-source or same-destination links. Degree penalties remain the evaluator’s responsibility.
